title: Canonical affine global Hom comparison for algebraic spaces
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] and algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], use the fixed small ringed module models, canonical internal Hom and K-injective direct image [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], the shared total left derived tensor pullback and counit [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback], its representative-normalized tensor comparison [def-sfb-space-pullback-tensor-comparison], and the original tensor-pullback adjunction [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Represent a scheme by its canonical algebraic space [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]; its identity is the terminal etale chart by [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests], with each source chart mapping to it by the Yoneda preimage of its composite with the structure map. Work in the unbounded categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and sizes [def-weil-size-convention]. For $Y\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $f:X\to Y$, define $\Gamma_{A,f}$ by the fixed basis equivalence, actual module direct image along $f$, evaluation at the terminal chart, and restriction along $A\cong\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$. This is additive. Define $G_{A,f}=R\Gamma_{A,f}$ and $H_{A,f}(P,Q)=G_{A,f}(R\mathcal Hom(P,Q))$. Its degree-$j$ cohomology is canonically the additive group $\operatorname{Hom}(P,Q[j])$. For any commuting square $hf=f'g$ over affine $Y,Y'$, define $\rho:A\to B$ using the affine section identifications. The actual global-sections comparison $\Gamma_{A,f}h_*\cong\operatorname{Res}_{\rho}\Gamma_{B,f'}$ is the unique one whose projection on every chart is the iterated direct-image projection. Its derived comparison $G_{A,f}Rh_*\cong\operatorname{Res}_{\rho}G_{B,f'}$ is the unique one satisfying the square with that ordinary comparison and the fixed right-derived units on every K-injective representative. The derived adjunction $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$ is the unique one whose unit, followed by $Rh_*$ of the shared left-derived counit, equals the ordinary adjunction unit followed by the fixed right-derived unit on complexes. Define $Lh^*R\mathcal Hom(P,Q)\to R\mathcal Hom(Lh^*P,Lh^*Q)$ as the transpose of pulled evaluation after the inverse normalized tensor comparison. Define the $A$-linear global-Hom pullback map by applying $G_{A,f}$ to the $h$-unit, using the specified sections comparison, and then applying $G_{B,f'}$ to this internal-Hom map. Define its $B$-linear extension by the extension/restriction adjunction of [def-zl-ring-derived-scalar-extension]. These arrows are natural in both variables. No isomorphism of this last arrow, perfectness, boundedness, flatness, or quasi-coherence is asserted in this definition.
